alt: Real ChatGPT /flashcard execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: Prompt → send → generation (accelerated) → widget use (normal speed)
prompt: /flashcard Using only the attached chapter, create three interactive flashcards on tokens, context and probability versus truth. Include answer reveal, next/back and progress. Answer in English.

phases.name: generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT is generating the widget · accelerated.

phases.name: widget

actions.label: Flip the first card to reveal the answer.
Mark the card as known and advance to the next concept.
Reveal the second answer, then mark it for more practice.
The review advances while tracking learning progress.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos resize; padding only when needed. H.264 CRF16; original cadence and duration preserved. Original media retained in ignored local review archive.
